children: has laid out the compensation structure for incoming CEO John Ternus, giving investors an early look at how the company will tie his pay to performance and tenure.

Ternus is set to receive a targeted $58 million package for fiscal 2027. His compensation includes a $3 million salary and a $55 million equity award. Apple will also provide him with a $2.5 million stock award for his time as CEO during fiscal 2026.

Performance will account for most of Ternus' equity package. About 75% of the $55 million award will depend on Apple's results relative to other S&P 500 companies, while the remaining portion will vest over four years based on his continued service.
Tim Cook, who moved into the executive chairman role, will receive about $47 million for fiscal 2027, including a $2 million salary and $45 million in stock.
Ternus now faces an early test with Apple's Sept. 9 product event, where the company is expected to introduce its iPhone 18 lineup.
The pay structure puts greater emphasis on shareholder performance as Ternus begins his tenure.

title: Apple's New CEO John Ternus Gets a $58 Million Pay Package
